503:t_024:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ヒイロ$$, too! And Vice Foreign Minister $$ドーリアン$$ is no different!」

503:t_024:6.en:
$$ブライト$$
「You're the same as $$シャア$$! Don't think you can shoulder your family's destiny and everything else all by yourself!」

503:t_024:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Open your heart, $$リディ$$! Feel the will of $$ヒイロ$$ and $$リリーナ$$!」

503:t_025:2.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I hear $$マリーメイア・クシュリナーダ$$ once said that history dances an endless waltz in three-quarter time: war, peace, and revolution...」

503:t_025:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Then I will fight on, with you and the Gundam as my three beats, until peace comes, however endless the road...!」

503:t_026:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$リリーナ$$! I'm coming now!!」

503:t_027:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「What'll you do, $$リディ$$ buddy? $$ヒイロ$$ broke your trump card.」

503:t_027:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$ヒイロ$$ and $$リリーナ$$ fought without regard for their own lives... Even after this, will you claim that only you carry a special resolve?」

503:t_028:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Is that darkness deeper than we imagined...」

503:t_028:2.en:
$$メリーベル$$
「Aww... In the end, you didn't beat $c, and the Queen got taken away, too.」

503:t_028:3.en:
$$グエン$$
「No need to worry. His fight has only just begun.」

503:t_028:4.en:
$$グエン$$
「Let's withdraw ourselves before this gets troublesome.」

503:t_028:5.en:
$$グエン$$
(Someday, I hope to meet you again, $$ローラ$$.)

503:t_028:6.en:
$$メラン$$
「We've received word from Vice Foreign Minister $$ドーリアン$$. She seems to have a few injuries, but she's safe.」

503:t_028:7.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I see... So this victory is the result of $$ヒイロ$$ and her resolve surpassing that of Ensign $$リディ$$.」

503:t_028:8.en:
$$ゼクス$$
(Well done, $$リリーナ$$... And I've realized something in today's battle.)

503:t_028:9.en:
$$ゼクス$$
(The one who saves you is no longer me...)

503:t_029:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「With this many enemies, we'll take them down efficiently so we can rescue $$リリーナ$$ as soon as possible...!」

503:t_029:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(Wait for me, $$リリーナ$$. I'll be there soon...!)

503:t_100:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
($$リリーナ$$... I'll eliminate everyone who tries to use you.)

503:t_100:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(So you go down the path you believe in.)

503:t_101:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
(Wait for me, $$リリーナ$$. I will protect you.)

503:t_101:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
(That is the last duty of this foolish brother...!)

503:t_102:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
(Ensign $$リディ$$... Is this the result of seeing with your own eyes, hearing with your own ears, and acting on your own judgment?)

503:t_102:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
(If so, we won't hesitate to fight you...! But if not, we'll stop you and drive the way of a soldier into you all over again!)

503:t_103:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Our opponent is that black $$ユニコーン$$! All hands, concentrate!」

503:t_103:2.en:
$$レイアム$$
「But, Captain...! Ensign $$リディ$$ is in that...」

503:t_103:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「All the more reason! He's no ordinary pilot!」

503:t_103:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「Besides, a man like him won't die that easily! Don't hold back!」

503:t_104:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「With this machine, even if my opponent is Captain $$アムロ$$...!」

503:t_104:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I never meant to teach you to fight by relying on your machine, Ensign $$リディ$$!」

503:t_104:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「Right now I have to win by any means necessary!」

503:t_104:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's not resolve or anything of the sort! It's called obsession!」

503:t_104:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Wake up, $$リディ$$! Your talent didn't awaken for you to do something like this!」

503:t_105:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$カミーユ$$! If you get in my way, I won't spare even you!」

503:t_105:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are you saying you'll settle our contest like this!?」

503:t_105:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You said you'd fight fair and square and take the ace's seat on the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ from me!」

503:t_105:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「That's all in the past! I'm fighting as $$クロノ$$ to protect the future!」

503:t_106:0.en:
$$エマ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! So in the end, you've been absorbed by the $$マーセナス家$$!?」

503:t_106:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Even if it's not a road I chose by choice, it's all I have now!」

503:t_106:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「I'm going through, Lieutenant $$エマ$$! I'm not the man I used to be!」

503:t_107:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Don't think you can stop me now, $$カツ$$!」

503:t_107:2.en:
$$カツ$$
「You know full well, Ensign, that I'm not someone who loses to threats like that!」

503:t_107:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「Then I'll shut you up with sheer strength!」

503:t_107:4.en:
$$カツ$$
「If you're not the man you used to be, then neither am I! Get ready!」

503:t_108:0.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「You've sunk to selling yourself cheap, $$リディ$$.」

503:t_108:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「I won't make excuses! This is who I am now, Captain $$ナイジェル$$!」

503:t_108:2.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「A soldier has no use for excuses or any such crap! As I see it, you're a deserter who left the unit on your own say-so!」

503:t_108:3.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Like a soldier, report what you learned to your superiors! A rookie who can't even do that isn't going to be my opponent!」

503:t_109:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「Stop, Ensign $$リディ$$! Share what you're carrying with us!」

503:t_109:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Don't trample on people's hearts, $$イノベイター$$! Because of people like you, $$クロノ$$ exists!」

503:t_109:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「Forgive me, $$刹那$$! Your existence can't be allowed, for the world's sake!」

503:t_110:0.en:
$$シン$$
「Remember, Ensign $$リディ$$! We're comrades who fought together, aren't we!?」

503:t_110:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$シン$$... If only you weren't a $$コーディネイター$$...」

503:t_110:2.en:
$$シン$$
「So $$クロノ$$ really doesn't accept the existence of Coordinators!」

503:t_110:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「I won't wave around childish sentimentality! But your existence can't be allowed!」

503:t_110:4.en:
$$シン$$
「I won't let you take Coordinators' lives with some nonsensical logic like that!」

503:t_110:5.en:
$$シン$$
「Ensign! If you're coming at us by force, I'll face you head-on!」

503:t_111:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! Where did the man who fought for $$オードリー$$ go!?」

503:t_111:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「My fight is also to save her! If I get the Box and wipe out $$ネオ・ジオン$$, $$ミネバ$$ can become just an ordinary woman!」

503:t_111:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「...It's the only way! The only one!」

503:t_111:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「A self-righteous way like that won't change anything, Ensign $$リディ$$! So please, stop fighting!」

503:t_112:0.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「$$バンシィ$$...! The positions are reversed this time!」

503:t_112:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$マリーダ$$, is that you!」

503:t_112:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Since it doesn't respond to me, it seems you've cut the NT-D's functions!」

503:t_112:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「I won't lose even without that thing!」

503:t_112:4.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Wake up! Will continuing a fight like this serve the future you want!?」

503:t_112:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「It will! If I defeat $$バナージ$$ and destroy $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」
